$comment: The stories on imaginelivetv.com, in the order the landing page lists them. Each one's scenes are in story/<id>.json. Fields: id (the data file's name), logline (one line for its card), image (its card's key image, 9:16; without one the card shows the first video's opening frame) and alt (what the image shows), pages (where its branch pages live: "/" for The Final Spark only, every other story under /<id>/), listed (false: built and playable at /?story=<id>, but not on the landing page). `npm run story` builds them all. Story doc: story/README.md.

stories.logline: You wake in a sewer with no name and no past. A rat is watching. Every page costs a match.
stories.alt: A rat sitting on a rusted pipe
